meaning.rationale: Subsection (c) expressly establishes an emergency exception making the use of a hand-held mobile telephone permissible by drivers of a CMV when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services.

targets.affected_action: Carves out an exception to the prohibition against a driver using a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV, permitting such use when necessary to communicate with law enforcement officials or other emergency services; all other hand-held mobile telephone use while driving remains prohibited.
targets.rationale: F005 explicitly makes using a hand-held mobile telephone permissible by drivers of a CMV in the specified emergency circumstances, directly qualifying the general driver prohibition established in F002.

targets.affected_action: No change is supported; the prohibition against motor carriers allowing or requiring their drivers to use a hand-held mobile telephone while driving a CMV remains completely unaffected.
targets.rationale: F005 limits the emergency permission strictly to 'drivers of a CMV' and does not state an exception for motor carriers or authorize motor carriers to allow or require drivers to use hand-held mobile telephones under F003. Applying this qualification to C0001 would wrongly admit motor carriers requiring or directing hand-held phone use in emergencies without source support.
